Money Masteries · Credential Revalidation Office
Foreign Education & School Credit Revalidation
Independent evaluation of foreign academic credentials against United States equivalency standards.
In plain terms: if you studied or graduated outside the United States, we compare your foreign diploma, transcript, or coursework against U.S. equivalency standards and give you a written report you can use for school, work, or licensing applications.
What We Do

We review your foreign diploma, transcript, or school credits and issue a written U.S. equivalency report — proof your education meets American standards.

Who It's For

Anyone who studied outside the United States and needs that education evaluated here.

What You Receive

A written report you can give to schools, employers, or licensing boards.

Turnaround

Most evaluations start within a few business days.

Our Process
Enroll & Submit Your Information
Choose your plan below and complete secure checkout — no account or login required.
Provide Your Academic Records
After enrolling, you'll be contacted to submit your transcripts, diplomas, or school records for review.
Evaluation Against U.S. Standards
Your foreign credentials are compared against United States equivalency standards to determine the U.S. equivalent of your education.
Receive Your Revalidation Report
You receive a written report you can provide to schools, employers, or licensing boards that request one.
Important disclaimer: This service only revalidates/evaluates foreign educational credentials for U.S. equivalency purposes. It does not guarantee a job, and it does not provide, sponsor, or guarantee any kind of work visa or immigration status. It only revalidates a person's education for use in the United States.

🤝 Buyer / Acquisition Readiness
78
Good — mostly buyer-ready.

Your financials are clean and trending up, but a few gaps (see checklist below) are typically the first things a buyer's diligence team flags. Closing those raises both your score and your sale price.

✅
12+ months of clean, reconciled books
Buyers want at least 2-3 years — you're building toward that.
✅
Revenue trending up, low customer concentration
No single client is more than 15% of revenue.
✅
Business bank accounts separate from personal
Clean separation makes due diligence far faster.
⚠️
Documented SOPs / processes not yet uploaded
Buyers pay more for a business that doesn't depend on the owner.
⚠️
Only 1 of 3 years of financials on file
Connect prior-year accounts or upload past statements to strengthen this.
⚠️
No formal valuation / broker opinion yet
Get a CPA or business broker to validate the multiple below before listing.
What a Buyer Will Want to See
Everything below is what an acquirer (or their diligence team) typically reviews first when deciding whether — and how much — to offer.
ItemValue / StatusWhy it matters
Annual Revenue (TTM)$578,400Top-line size sets the ballpark for valuation.
SDE / Owner's Discretionary Earnings$341,200The real number most small-business buyers price off of.
Net Profit Margin59.0%Higher margins = more resilient, more attractive business.
YoY Revenue Growth+18.6%Growth trend supports a higher multiple.
Recurring / Repeat Revenue34% of totalPredictable income lowers perceived risk.
Customer ConcentrationLargest client 12%Diversified client base reduces buyer risk.
Suggested Valuation Multiple2.6x - 3.2x SDETypical range for this size & industry (illustrative).
Estimated Business Value$887,000 - $1,092,000SDE × multiple — a starting point, not an appraisal.
Outstanding Debt / Liabilities$14,200Buyers subtract this from any offer.
Owner Time Involvement~18 hrs/weekLower owner dependency = easier transition, higher value.

Base URL: https://us-central1-money-masteries-2cc76.cloudfunctions.net/crmApi
Header on every request: X-API-Key: <your key above>

GET ?resource=clients|projects|invoices[&id=xxx] — list, or get one
POST ?resource=clients|projects|invoices — create (JSON body = fields)
PATCH ?resource=clients|projects|invoices&id=xxx — update (JSON body = fields to merge)
DELETE ?resource=clients|projects|invoices&id=xxx — delete

Example: curl -H "X-API-Key: YOUR_KEY" "https://us-central1-money-masteries-2cc76.cloudfunctions.net/crmApi?resource=clients"

How You Get Paid
The affiliate & team commission program, in plain terms
Direct Commissions
When someone joins with your affiliate link or referral number, you earn a commission on their membership every time they pay — up to 50% on Elite and Pro plans.
Team Overrides
You also earn a smaller override on what your direct recruits' own recruits pay in — so building a team compounds your income.
Automatic Crediting
There's nothing to claim. The moment someone signs up through your link or number, they're placed in your downline and every payment they make credits you automatically.
Want the exact numbers? Open Payouts/Bank → Compensation Plan to see current rates, or your own live team tree to see exactly who's on it and what they're earning you.
